zh: 图鉴妖怪卡框（铜/银/金/玉，中心透出）

sheet.normalizeNote: provider returned square 1254x1254; aspect-preserving LANCZOS downscale to requested 1024x1024 before split

transparency.method: provider returned REAL alpha PNG (corners and all four center windows alpha=0); no chroma key needed. Post-processing: sub-visible alpha(<16) zeroed, isolated faint specks(<25px, peak alpha<200) removed, solid(alpha>=64) bbox crop + exact 12px transparent pad
transparency.note: prompt requested solid magenta background as chroma fallback; provider instead produced true transparency. alpha 1-2 red/yellow spill pixels present in raw (invisible) were removed by threshold

qc.split: gpt-image-pipeline split_asset_sheet.py grid mode (deterministic halves, no --trim)
qc.checks: corners transparent, center window 9-point transparent, zero fringe spill (red/magenta near transparency), zero visible pixels within 4px edge band, alpha 0-255, no yellow fringe on bronze/silver/jade, cut lines cross-checked (7 noise px only)
qc.visualCheck: all 4 frames inspected after processing: identical ornament design, distinct materials, centers empty, gold star sparkles preserved
